name: Generic Python
description: Run any Python application inside an isolated virtualenv with requirements.txt installed.
installScript: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

files.main.py:
import json
import os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        body = json.dumps({"ok": True, "service": "terrypanel-python-app", "path": self.path}).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    port = int(os.environ.get("PORT", "8000"))
    print(f"Listening on http://0.0.0.0:{port}", flush=True)
    HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", port), Handler).serve_forever()
